headword: {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}

definitions.gloss: credit limit; usage limit (amount); spending cap
definitions.explanation: The maximum amount that a user is permitted to charge, withdraw, or spend — most commonly the credit limit on a credit card, but also used for debit cards, prepaid cards, point services, and other usage-based accounts.

examples.japanese: {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}は50{万円|まんえん}です。
クレジットカードの{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げたい。
examples.english: I want to raise the credit limit on my credit card.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}はもう{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}に{達|たっ}してしまったので、カードが{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: I've already hit my credit limit for this month, so I can't use the card.

examples.japanese: カード{会社|がいしゃ}に{連絡|れんらく}すれば、{利用限度額|りようげんどがく}を{一時的|いちじてき}に{増額|ぞうがく}してもらえる{場合|ばあい}もあります。
examples.english: If you contact the card company, they may be able to temporarily raise your credit limit.

notes:
Composed of {利用|りよう} (use, utilization), {限度|げんど} (limit), and {額|がく} (amount, sum). The standard term used on credit card statements, banking apps, and service contracts in Japan to refer to the maximum chargeable or usable amount.

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in the context of credit cards (クレジットカード), where it refers to the cardholder's credit limit. Also used for debit cards, prepaid cards, electronic money services, and subscription-style services that have a usage cap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}を{超|こ}える: to exceed the credit limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}に{達|たっ}する: to reach the credit limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる / {増額|ぞうがく}する: to raise the limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる: to lower the limit
- {利用限度額|りようげんどがく}の{設定|せってい}: setting of the limit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {限度額|げんどがく}: limit amount — the more general term; {利用限度額|りようげんどがく} specifies that it is a use/spending limit
- {与信枠|よしんわく}: credit line — the bank-side term for the credit extended to a cardholder; more technical
- {利用可能額|りようかのうがく}: available credit — the amount currently available to spend, i.e., the limit minus what has already been used
